description: Base Renovate configuration for Arillso repositories

packageRules.description: Pre-1.0 packages: SemVer does not guarantee backward compatibility; treat any non-patch bump as potentially breaking and require manual review.

Release binaries installed via helper actions (e.g. jaxxstorm/action-install-gh-release, aquasecurity/setup-trivy) are pinned by release tag, not by digest. Forcing pinDigests here makes Renovate fail with 'update failure' (Digest is not updated), so disable it for these uses-with inputs.

Docker images referenced as a bare version string (no @sha256 slot), e.g. kubesec/kubesec via an env var, cannot carry a digest. Forcing pinDigests makes Renovate fail with 'update failure' (Digest is not updated), so disable it for these.

arillso/.github - date tags, no digest pinning, weekly rollout. merge.yml cuts a YYYY-MM-DD tag on every push to main, so a daily schedule opens one PR per workflow change in every consumer repo (16 tags in the 30 days to 2026-09-12). Batching the rollout to Monday keeps the rolling-release model while cutting consumer PR churn to roughly 4 per month. `groupSlug` is what carries the schedule, not `groupName`: Renovate derives the branch from `slugify(groupSlug ?? groupName)` and evaluates `schedule` per branch, and packageRules merge last-wins per key - so the `groupSlug: all-non-major` from the non-major rule above survives a bare `groupName` override here (a tag bump like 2026-09-05 -> 2026-09-06 is a patch under this rule's own regex versioning - the month is `minor`, the day is `patch` - and that rule matches both, so it does match). Without an explicit groupSlug the bump lands on `renovate/all-non-major` and this window either does nothing or defers every other non-major update with it. `minimumReleaseAge` is deliberately waived: the Monday window is itself the soak, and a 1-day gate would push any tag cut over the weekend past the window and on to the next Monday, an 8-day lag. An urgent workflow fix is still reachable on demand via the Dependency Dashboard checkbox.

ghcr.io never reports a release timestamp: Renovate's docker datasource reads timestamps only from Docker Hub (`tag_last_pushed`). Under `minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour: timestamp-optional` these updates already merge without a cooldown, but log a 'did not have a releaseTimestamp' warning on every run; waiving the gate here makes that deliberate. This also lifts the 7-day major gate for ghcr.io images, which could never work without a timestamp. Two rules: the package name form and the registryUrls form (bare host from `registryUrlTemplate`).
Same waiver when ghcr.io sits in registryUrls instead of the package name. Regex instead of a glob so the bare host form `https://ghcr.io` matches as well.

Digest updates of arillso's own Docker Hub images (e.g. arillso/ansible, rebuilt under the same version tag by docker.ansible) have no release timestamp: the action.playbook Mend log of 2026-11-07 15:25 lists the arillso/ansible:2.21.5 digest update as the only timestamp-less upgrade, although Docker Hub reports tag_last_pushed for that tag. Waived explicitly because the images are first-party and built by arillso CI. Limited to digest updates, so version updates keep their cooldown.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Monthly, the whole first Wednesday (day of month AND day of week must both match in Renovate cron), away from the Monday batch that bumps the arillso/.github tag and GitHub Actions on the same lockfile. A lock file refresh has no release timestamp, so the age gate is waived and the refresh automerges on green CI without a cooldown. Trade-off: vulnerabilityAlerts only cover dependencies declared in a package file, so a vulnerable transitive dependency can wait up to about five weeks for this refresh instead of one.

customManagers.description: Update versions in comments (renovate: datasource=... depName=...). An optional @sha256:... suffix is captured separately as currentDigest, so digest-pinned image references (e.g. image: repo:tag@sha256:...) update the digest instead of mangling the whole string into currentValue.
Update pinned Renovate preset versions from arillso/.github
